shows.name: KTEQ Solid Gold
shows.tagline: KTEQ's equivalent of a plain black T-shirt.
shows.description: An ever-evolving blend of 70s, 80s, and 90s punk and alternative classics, with some deep cuts, rare gems, and edge cases thrown in for good measure.

shows.name: Live on KTEQ
shows.description: Live DJ shows will return Fall 2026 when the refurbished studio reopens, but some DJs will be contributing to voice tracked segments later this spring and summer. Stay tuned for more information.

shows.name: The Digital Years
shows.description: It's probably a coincidence, but who knows?  KTEQ loses its broadcast license (whoops, for a decade+) and blogs suddenly rule? Pitchfork is the tastemaker?  Vibes here cover artists who came of age and flourished during KTEQ's streaming-only era of the Naughties and Teens.
